Don't Modify/Redistribute till 2028

Author: Benjamin "Sweden" Jillson

I'm well aware that I've put this repo under open source, however, there is still major work to be done to the core. And if a change is made that drastically changes the engine, I don't want other forks or projects wanting to benefit from this repo to be greatly affected. So just give me some time to fix some muck that's still in the system. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Additionally, I'd like for ya'll to not port this to other systems/engines, or at least distribute those ports publicly. Because either I'd like to make those ports myself, OR at the very least, give me a year to relish in the fruits of my labor, I've really worked really hard on all this and I think it's fair to give me some time to work with it before people go and use a different of the variation of the tool, when/if that time comes.

Thank you for understanding. -Sweden.
